transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what finally got me to come in is that I'm having a lot of trouble at work. I'm an electrician, and lately... I just can't keep my focus on one estimate or code form anymore. 

It's like every little thing distracts me. If I hear a tool noise in the background, or I get a text message, or even if I just get some new idea about the workshop, it completely pulls me off track. And because of that, my jobs are starting to get all mixed up. It's becoming a real issue, so I figured I needed to come in and talk to somebody.
Did you have this same kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?

No, not really. I mean, school was always fine for me. I didn't have any problems paying attention in class or getting my work done back then. This whole thing with not being able to focus... it's really just been happening lately. It definitely wasn't an issue when I was a kid.
Have you been feeling depressed lately?

No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling depressed. I mean, I'm frustrated with work, obviously, but my mood isn't down. If anything, I feel like I have more energy than usual, just... I can't channel it into what I'm supposed to be doing. But no, no depression.
Have you been needing less sleep than usual?

Yeah, actually, I have. It's been going on for months now. I'll sleep for maybe three or four hours, and then I just... pop right up. It'll be way before dawn, but I feel completely rested, like I got a full eight hours. I just wake up feeling totally ready to go—like I need to start pricing out materials, catching up on emails, or sketching out new wiring systems right then and there. I just don't feel tired at all.
Have you been feeling unusually upbeat or high lately?

Yeah, I have. I'll be in this really big, pumped-up mood, just talking like our little shop is about to become the main solar outfit in town. I get really into it. But then... if my wife or one of the apprentices questions the plan, I can just flip. I end up getting really sharp with them over practically nothing. So it's a great mood, but I guess I get set off pretty easily if people aren't on board.
Have you been taking on a lot more projects or activities than usual lately?

Yeah, I definitely have. I've just been going nonstop lately. 

I'm bouncing straight from job sites to putting together new bids, and then I'm right back in the workshop rewiring test panels. I keep... I keep starting these new home-automation ideas before I even finish the last one I was working on. It just feels like sitting still right now is a complete waste of time, you know? So I just keep taking more on.
Have these symptoms ever gotten severe enough that you were hospitalized for them?

No, nothing like that. I've never been hospitalized for any of this. I mean, I know I get pretty intense with work and my moods, but it's never... it hasn't ever gotten to the point where I needed to be in a hospital or anything.
During these high-energy periods, have you had any experiences that other people said were not real, like hearing or seeing things that others didn’t, or beliefs they thought were clearly untrue?

No, I haven't had anything like that happen. I mean, my ideas for the business might get a little out there, and I know I talk big, but I'm not... I don't see things or hear voices or anything like that. It's just a lot of energy and big plans, not things that aren't real.
About how long has this high-energy, upbeat and irritable period been going on without really letting up?

It's been going on for a while now. I'd say it's been building for about seven months. That's right around the time we took out the mortgage for the new workshop and all the upgraded equipment. Since then, it's just been this constant push.
